title: Which framework for this job?
intro: The course's real lesson is a taxonomy. Eight jobs — pick the framework whose model fits.

cards.text: A thin pipeline you control: draft in parallel, pick, send — with a guardrail
One specialist should take over the whole conversation on demand
A research desk: stable roles (finder, researcher, picker) with clean task hand-offs
Non-engineers should be able to tune behavior by editing role/goal text
A compliance flow where no step may ever be silently skipped, with resume-on-crash
Loop until an evaluator node passes, with every branch visible and testable
Open-ended brainstorm among several agents, speaker chosen dynamically
Same agent logic must run in-process today, distributed across machines later

debrief: Match the coordination model to the job: the SDK when you own the orchestration and want minimal abstraction (tools, handoffs, guardrails); CrewAI when the work is an org chart — stable roles, YAML the business can read; LangGraph when control flow is the requirement — explicit edges, checkpoints, determinism you can test; AutoGen when coordination is conversational or when the Runtime's decoupling (in-process today, distributed tomorrow) is the point. None is 'best' — the course's taxonomy is the skill.
